Loss report: forgejo -> concourse
[lost] pipeline/.shared/trigger/0 ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gha (event) is not written to the Concourse file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/.shared/trigger/0 trigger.api
[lost] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.filter.branches (the push trigger has no branch filter, and a git resource follows one branch; the resource follows the default branch of the repository)
[emulated] pipeline/.shared ext.passthrough: git-uri variable (the git resources read their uri from ((git-uri)); set it with fly set-pipeline -v git-uri=<uri> or in the credential manager)
[emulated] pipeline/.shared/job/run job.runner: worker tags of the task (the tasks carry the worker tags ubuntu-latest; a build waits until a worker has them)
[emulated] pipeline/.shared/job/run trigger.manual: get with no trigger (no trigger starts the job, so a person starts it)
[emulated] pipeline/.shared/job/run/step/run-step-1 step.image: default image (the task names no image, so it runs ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/ci ext.passthrough: git-uri variable (the git resources read their uri from ((git-uri)); set it with fly set-pipeline -v git-uri=<uri> or in the credential manager)
[emulated] pipeline/ci project.multi_pipeline: one pipeline file per IR pipeline under .concourse/ (each pipeline needs its own fly set-pipeline and gets its own triggers)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build job.runner: worker tags of the task (the tasks carry the worker tags ubuntu-latest; a build waits until a worker has them)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.image: default image (the task names no image, so it runs ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/trigger/1 trigger.tag: git resource with source.tag_filter (a tag trigger that also has a branch filter is lost, because one git resource cannot hold both sets)
